batch.description: HSTU B Unit (CSE/ECE/EEE, Science group) MCQ question bank, academic session 2015-2016 (Satt Academy year label 2015), transcribed 2026-10-31 from the publicly readable first page of each Satt Academy subject section (Physics 15 of 25, Chemistry 15 of 25, Higher Mathematics 13 of 25, English 15 of 25; page 2 of each subject section is login-gated on Satt Academy and was not fetched). 58 of the 60 publicly readable cards are included; 2 cards were excluded as incomplete in the source itself (see source document notes). Answers are Satt Academy's own marked answers (reading-mode correct marker cross-checked against the card's test-mode answer field); content is not cross-source verified. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: HSTU B Unit 2015 MCQ Question Bank & Solution (Satt Academy)
sourceDocuments.notes: HTML question bank at https://sattacademy.com/b-%E0%A6%87%E0%A6%89%E0%A6%A8%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%9F-98/all/mcq-questions , retrieved 2026-10-31; local copy sources/satt-hstu-b-2015.html (sha256 is of that 'all' page). Per-subject first-page fragments retrieved the same day via the site's own subject endpoints are stored under sources/satt-hstu-b-2015/ (physics/chemistry/math/english -p1.html). Page 2 of each subject section redirects to the login page and was NOT fetched or bypassed, so 42 of the advertised 100 questions are not in this pack. MathML formulas are transcribed in a linear text form (e.g. x^2, (a)/(b), |z-5|, ^{64}_{28}Cu). Excluded as incomplete in the source itself: Higher Mathematics #5 and #7 (option c is blank in the source card). No independent second source was provided for this paper, so content is unverified.
